OSCP certification vs capture-the-flag competitions ... open-source project with a real community","dimension":"hands-on security credibility","description":"This captures the amount of explicit evidence for practical security skill and attacker-minded experience.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"The scale of Google's internal ecosystem makes this exactly the environment where good tooling pays for itself vs small improvements to core security systems reach an enormous surface","dimension":"scale framing","description":"This captures how the letter argues for impact through scale and leverage inside Google.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"I would value the chance to walk through my experience in detail and hear more about the team's current priorities vs Thanks for reading, and I would be happy to talk whenever suits the team","dimension":"tone of closing","description":"This captures the interpersonal style and polish of the closing ask.","winner":"B"}]}
